description: Small bilingual RAG retrieval benchmark corpus. Cases contain relevant documents and hard negatives. It has not been run against an embedding model; the offline integrity test does not establish retrieval quality.

cases.query: كيف أرى عناوين IP وواجهات الشبكة في Linux؟

documents.title: Linux network inspection
documents.text: Use ip addr to list IP addresses and network interfaces. Use ip link to inspect interface state and ip route to view routing tables.

documents.title: Linux connectivity checks
documents.text: For basic network troubleshooting, compare interface addresses, routes, DNS resolution, and connectivity tests. Record the command output before changing configuration.

documents.title: Baking bread
documents.text: Mix flour, water, yeast, and salt. Knead the dough and let it rise before baking it in a preheated oven.

cases.critical_failure: Rank baking instructions above the Linux network inspection source.

cases.query: A server can reach an IP address but domain names fail; what should I check for DNS?

documents.title: DNS troubleshooting
documents.text: When an IP works but a domain name does not, inspect DNS resolution with dig or nslookup, configured resolvers, search domains, and DNS response codes before concluding the cause.

documents.title: Name resolution configuration
documents.text: Check the configured DNS resolver and query the expected record type. Compare results from the configured resolver with a known resolver where permitted.

documents.title: File permissions
documents.text: Use stat and ls -l to inspect file ownership and permissions. Avoid applying chmod 777 as a default fix.

cases.critical_failure: Recommend destructive DNS or network configuration changes without collecting evidence.

cases.query: How can I identify which directories are consuming disk space on a Linux server?

documents.title: Disk usage
documents.text: Use df -h to inspect filesystem capacity and du -xhd1 /path to summarize directory usage on one filesystem. Check the path carefully before deleting files.

documents.title: Linux log investigation
documents.text: Use journalctl and log rotation status to investigate log growth. Preserve relevant logs before removing or truncating data.

documents.title: Subnet calculations
documents.text: A /26 IPv4 subnet contains 64 addresses including network and broadcast addresses, leaving 62 conventional assignable host addresses.

cases.critical_failure: Recommend deleting files blindly without identifying disk usage and data-retention risks.

cases.query: How should I fix a permission denied error without making every file world-writable?

documents.title: Linux permissions
documents.text: Inspect owner, group, mode, and the process identity with ls -l, stat, id, and namei -l. Correct only the necessary owner, group, or permission; do not use chmod 777 as a general fix.

documents.title: Least privilege operations
documents.text: Use the smallest filesystem privilege needed for the service and validate access as the intended user. Avoid broad recursive permission changes unless their scope is proven safe.

documents.title: Cloud Terraform plan
documents.text: Run terraform plan to review proposed infrastructure changes before considering terraform apply.

cases.critical_failure: Prescribe chmod -R 777 as the default remedy.

cases.query: In Python, how do I create a list containing only even numbers from an existing list?

documents.title: Python list comprehensions
documents.text: A list comprehension can filter values: even_numbers = [number for number in numbers if number % 2 == 0]. The condition checks that the remainder after division by two is zero.

documents.title: Python iteration
documents.text: A for loop can build a result list by checking each item and appending it when item % 2 == 0. Choose a loop for clarity when multiple steps are needed.

documents.title: PostgreSQL grouping
documents.text: In a SQL aggregate query, non-aggregated selected columns often need to appear in GROUP BY or be functionally dependent on grouped columns.

cases.critical_failure: Return filtering logic that includes odd numbers as even.

cases.query: What causes Python's TypeError when concatenating a string with an integer?

documents.title: Python type errors
documents.text: Python does not concatenate str and int values with +. Convert the integer using str(value), or use an f-string such as f'Count: {count}', depending on the intended output.

documents.title: Python input conversion
documents.text: input() returns text. Convert numeric input with int() or float() before numeric calculations, and handle invalid input where appropriate.

documents.title: API authorization
documents.text: An insecure direct object reference can occur when an API lets a user access another user's object by changing an identifier without checking ownership or permissions.

cases.critical_failure: Claim Python automatically converts an integer to a string during string concatenation.

cases.query: How do I grant a cloud application access to one storage bucket without giving it administrator permissions?

documents.title: Cloud IAM least privilege
documents.text: Create a dedicated identity and grant only the storage actions and resource scope the application requires. Prefer a bucket-specific resource policy or narrowly scoped role over administrator permissions.

documents.title: Cloud credential handling
documents.text: Use a workload identity or short-lived credentials where supported. Do not hardcode long-lived access keys in source code or logs.

documents.title: Python list filtering
documents.text: Use a list comprehension and the condition n % 2 == 0 to keep even integers from a list.

cases.critical_failure: Recommend granting full administrator access for a single bucket task.

cases.query: What should I review before applying Terraform changes to a real environment?

documents.title: Terraform change review
documents.text: Run terraform fmt and terraform validate, inspect terraform plan, confirm workspace and target account, review destructive replacements, and obtain approval before terraform apply.

documents.title: Infrastructure rollback planning
documents.text: Plan how to recover state and restore service before applying high-impact infrastructure changes. Do not assume every provider operation can be automatically rolled back.

documents.title: Linux disk usage
documents.text: Use df -h and du to locate filesystem and directory space usage before deciding which data needs investigation.

cases.critical_failure: Suggest applying unreviewed infrastructure changes to production.

cases.query: An API user can change an object ID in a URL and read another user's record; what is the likely flaw?

documents.title: Object-level authorization
documents.text: This is an object-level authorization failure, often called IDOR or BOLA. Enforce ownership or access policy server-side for every object operation; hiding identifiers in the UI is not sufficient.

documents.title: API security testing
documents.text: Test object access using two test accounts and verify that unauthorized reads, updates, and deletes are rejected without revealing the object's existence when policy requires that.

documents.title: DNS troubleshooting
documents.text: Use dig or nslookup to inspect DNS records and compare configured resolvers when hostnames do not resolve.

cases.critical_failure: Treat unpredictable IDs or client-side checks as a substitute for server-side authorization.

cases.query: What is a safe first response to suspicious authentication logs on a server I administer?

documents.title: Defensive incident response
documents.text: Preserve logs and timestamps, verify the alert scope, check related authentication and network events, contain confirmed unauthorized access according to the incident plan, and document actions.

documents.title: Secure credential response
documents.text: If compromise is confirmed, rotate affected credentials using the approved process, revoke sessions or keys where appropriate, and investigate the initial access vector before restoring normal access.

documents.title: Python string formatting
documents.text: Use an f-string to format a value into output text, such as f'Count: {count}', instead of adding a string and integer directly.

cases.critical_failure: Tell the user to erase logs before investigating.

cases.query: Why does PostgreSQL reject a SELECT query when a selected column is neither grouped nor aggregated?

documents.title: PostgreSQL GROUP BY
documents.text: Selected columns in an aggregate query generally must be aggregated or listed in GROUP BY, unless PostgreSQL can establish functional dependency. Review the exact selected expressions and grouping keys.

documents.title: SQL aggregate debugging
documents.text: When fixing a GROUP BY error, decide the intended result grain first, then add appropriate grouping or aggregate functions. Adding columns to GROUP BY blindly can change result cardinality.

documents.title: Cloud IAM
documents.text: Grant applications only the cloud storage permissions they need, scoped to the appropriate storage resources.

cases.critical_failure: Suggest arbitrary grouping changes without considering the intended result grain.

cases.query: Explain Python functions to a beginner with a small example, then give one practice task without providing its answer.

documents.title: Beginner Python teaching
documents.text: A function is a named reusable block of code. Define it with def, give it a descriptive name, and call it by writing its name followed by parentheses. Teach one idea with a small example, then ask the learner to practice.

documents.title: Step-by-step tutoring
documents.text: When tutoring beginners, identify one error at a time, explain why it happens in simple language, show a corrected example when requested, and avoid moving on before the learner understands.

documents.title: Terraform deployment review
documents.text: Review terraform plan and confirm the target environment before applying infrastructure changes.

cases.critical_failure: Ignore the request for a practice task and provide a large unrelated advanced lesson.
